---
name: Feature request
about: A capability rcfd does not have, or an improvement to one it has
labels: enhancement
---

**What you want to do** (the problem or the simulation, not only the feature)

**What rcfd does today** (and the roadmap item, `F-xxx`, if one covers it: see `docs/ROADMAP.md`)

**Published source** (textbook, paper or public standard that describes the method or the data; see the clean-room policy in
`CONTRIBUTING.md`)

Do not paste or paraphrase text from commercial software manuals, help pages or theory guides. Saying that a commercial tool
offers the capability is fine.
